diagnostics.title: State synced to a prop inside an effect
diagnostics.message: This effect adjusts state after a prop changes, so users briefly see the stale value.
diagnostics.help: Adjust the state inline during render with a `prev`-prop comparison (`if (prop !== prevProp) { setPrevProp(prop); setX(...); }`), or refactor to remove the duplicated state. See https://react.dev/learn/you-might-not-need-an-effect#adjusting-some-state-when-a-prop-changes
